body:
**Restacked on #456.** The base is now `feature/niw2-586-background-toasts` (#456, the top of the Prepare stack: #448 ← #458 ← #455 ← #457 ← #456). I merged that branch into this one in 13b7ff5d, with no force push.

### Conflicts and how they were resolved
Everything from both sides is kept.

- **`video-card.tsx`**: an original shows the MASTER · FULL QUALITY tag (#457) in place of the kind badge. The capture pill stays hidden for an imported video (#447).
- **`library-page.tsx`**: the page now uses both the `prepare` and `backgroundCopy` translators. Header layout: title + "✓ N copy ready" chip on the left (subtitle below), with Sync · "Prepare a video" · "Import a video" (primary) on the right.
- **`en.json` / `es.json`**: #456 removed the unused `prepare.*` keys, and that stays. The drop-zone keys and `prepareAVideo` from #459 are added back on top. I checked the code: none of the removed keys are referenced.
- **`library-page.test.tsx`** (both branches added it): now one file built on #456's mocked library. It covers Import (button, drop zone, drop anywhere), "Prepare a video", the ready-copies chip and outline, and a new check of the header order (chip by the title, then Prepare, then Import).
- **`video-row.test.tsx`, `library-detail-page.test.tsx`**: the "Imported" tests now sit next to the Master / Send to… tests.
- **Docs**: the backlog index keeps both rows (background copies, drop into Prepare) plus the import and supporter-license rows, and the sidebar keeps both entries.

`bun run verify` passes locally: 317 test files, 3086 tests. I have not run the app in Electron.

### Still carries #447
This branch still contains #447's commits (`feature/niw2-579-import-video`, Import a video into the Library, based on `main`). Either merge #447 into the stack before #459, or review it as part of this PR. Otherwise the diff against the new base includes the import feature.

### How to test it yourself
1. Check out `feature/niw2-587-prepare-drop-zone`, run `bun install` and `bun run rebuild:native`, then start the desktop app.
2. Library: the header shows the title, then Sync, Prepare a video and Import a video. Finish a copy from Prepare and come back: the "✓ 1 copy ready" chip sits next to the title.
3. Originals show MASTER · FULL QUALITY and a Send to… button. An imported video shows "Imported" and no capture pill.
4. Click "Prepare a video": Prepare opens with the drop zone. Drop an MP4 there: it is imported, and Prepare opens on it.

> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Merged `main` up the stack. Two things changed in this PR's import code, not just conflict markers:

- a8c1679f: main's vault no longer creates a record for an id with neither a record nor media (ADR 0035), so every import failed with `copy-failed`. The import now reserves its stem with `vault.reserve`, places the copy without replacing anything, and gives back only what it made. A clash now gets ` (2)`, the suffix every capture uses, instead of `-2`.
- 4ab94fde (merge): the import handlers run inside the workspace gate and under one vault lease. The preload sends the workspace stamp (`scopedInvoke`), and the dialog stays outside the gate so a workspace switch never waits on the user. The Import dialog is refused before it opens while "Check and fix files" runs.

Not done here: imported items keep the `imported-<timestamp>` stem instead of a title-based name.
